title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Accounts Schedule: The Alignment Correction Authorization Amount
content:
The authorization amount is half the correction quote plus the alignment check charge standing unpaid on the order, rounded to the cent, half up. The correction quote is the tier's alignment correction fee.

This is the amount the customer pays to authorize a four-wheel alignment correction on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order.

## Quantities, defined

- **Correction quote:** the tier's alignment correction fee, in US dollars.
- **Share collected:** half (0.5) of the correction quote.
- **Alignment check charge standing on the order:** the alignment check charge in the order's calibration money history, less the write-offs booked against that charge.
- **Alignment check charge standing unpaid:** the part of the standing alignment check charge that exceeds the payments already made on the order; where the payments already made equal or exceed it, nothing stands unpaid (never below zero).
- **Authorization amount:** half the correction quote, plus the alignment check charge standing unpaid; that sum is rounded to the cent, half up. Half up means a figure whose fraction of a cent is one half or more goes up to the next cent, and a figure short of the half cent by no more than 0.0001 of a cent is treated as reaching it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: correction fee 129.95 USD, alignment check charge 59.95 USD, no write-offs against it)

| Payments already made on the order | Check charge standing unpaid | Half the correction quote | Sum | Authorization amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 59.95 | 64.975 | 124.925 | 124.93 |
| 30.00 | 29.95 | 64.975 | 94.925 | 94.93 |
| 80.00 | 0.00 | 64.975 | 64.975 | 64.98 |

Worked through for the first row: half of 129.95 is 64.975; adding the 59.95 standing unpaid gives 124.925; rounded to the cent, half up, the authorization amount is 124.93 USD.

## With a write-off against the check charge (hypothetical)

Alignment check charge 59.95 USD with a 10.00 USD write-off booked against it, and no payments: the charge standing is 49.95 USD, all of it unpaid; half the correction quote of 129.95 is 64.975; the sum is 114.925 and the authorization amount is 114.93 USD.
